content.layout: 3 columns x 2 rows, Case 1 to Case 6 in reading order

diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG canvas (16:9) draw six angle pictures in a grid of 3 columns x 2 rows in reading order. Each picture is one horizontal base arm and one cover arm that share the same start point (the hinge), both arms 1.5 units long, INK, 4 px, with no dot and no arrowhead at the hinge. The cover arm is turned counter-clockwise from the base arm by the opening given below. Case 1: hinge at (-5.2, 2.4), base arm to (-3.7, 2.4), cover arm turned 40 degrees, ending at (-4.05, 3.36), caption centred at (-5.2, 0.5). Case 2: hinge at (0, 2.4), base arm to (1.5, 2.4), cover arm turned 130 degrees, ending at (-0.96, 3.55), caption centred at (0, 0.5). Case 3: hinge at (5.2, 2.4), base arm to (6.7, 2.4), cover arm turned 180 degrees, ending at (3.7, 2.4), caption centred at (5.2, 0.5). Case 4: hinge at (-5.2, -2.1), base arm to (-3.7, -2.1), cover arm turned 210 degrees, ending at (-6.5, -2.85), caption centred at (-5.2, -4). Case 5: hinge at (0, -2.1), base arm to (1.5, -2.1), cover arm turned 290 degrees, ending at (0.51, -3.51), caption centred at (0, -4). Case 6: hinge at (5.2, -2.1), base arm to (6.7, -2.1), cover arm turned 340 degrees, ending at (6.61, -2.61), caption centred at (5.2, -4). In each picture draw a thin FOCUS arc (2.5 px) of radius 0.5 around the hinge that starts on the base arm and sweeps counter-clockwise by the same opening to the cover arm, with a small filled FOCUS arrowhead at the cover-arm end (for Case 3 the arc is a half circle, for Case 6 it is almost a full circle). Write the captions Case 1 to Case 6 in INK at the stated centres. Draw nothing else.
must_not_show: the words arm, vertex, angle or turn
a dot or label at any hinge
the girl or any book illustration
accuracy_checks: 6 pictures with identical arm lengths (1.5); openings 40, 130, 180, 210, 290, 340 degrees increase from Case 1 to Case 6, as the book says
Case 3 arms form one straight line (opening 180 degrees)
no number or word other than the six captions is drawn
diagram.alt_text: Six pictures of a book cover turning about its hinge, the opening growing from a narrow gap in Case 1 to almost a full turn in Case 6.
diagram.render_note: Schematic of Vidya's six book pictures (page 5): pages = horizontal arm, cover = turned arm, turn arc replaces the red arrows. The book prints no sizes; the openings (40, 130, 180, 210, 290, 340 degrees) are read by eye from the page picture and only their increasing order is stated by the book text. Cases 4 to 6 pass the straight position, so their arcs are longer than a half circle. Case 1 and Case 2 are identical to M1.S5.T5.C24.IMG2.

diagram.manim_description: Draw the picture of M1.S6.T6.C27.IMG1 unchanged (same six panels, same positions, same INK arms, FOCUS turn arcs and INK captions Case 1 to Case 6). Then add, in every one of the six panels, in ANSWER: a filled dot of radius 0.1 on the hinge; a 7 px ANSWER stroke drawn behind each of the two INK arms so that both arms show a green halo with the INK arm still visible on top; the word vertex; and the word arm once beside each arm. Positions of the added words: Case 1: vertex at (-6, 2.11), arm (base arm) at (-4.2, 2.7), arm (cover arm) at (-4.84, 3.25). Case 2: vertex at (0, 1.55), arm (base arm) at (0.9, 2.7), arm (cover arm) at (-0.85, 2.76). Case 3: vertex at (5.2, 3.25), arm (base arm) at (6.1, 2.7), arm (cover arm) at (4.37, 2.05). Case 4: vertex at (-5.2, -1.25), arm (base arm) at (-4.3, -1.8), arm (cover arm) at (-5.7, -2.88). Case 5: vertex at (-1.15, -2.1), arm (base arm) at (0.9, -1.8), arm (cover arm) at (0.68, -2.73). Case 6: vertex at (4.05, -2.1), arm (base arm) at (6.1, -1.8), arm (cover arm) at (5.86, -2.71). Every added word is centred on its position, written in ANSWER. Draw nothing else.
